notes: Records 151-300 of MathBook2 (parsed_items.jsonl lines 2641-2790). Coverage: binomial expansion (HM2 Ch5, records 153-196), conics (HM2 Ch6, records 197-278), inverse trigonometric functions and trigonometric equations (HM2 Ch7, records 279-300). Records 151-152 are the tail of the polynomial chapter and re-exercise a b15 skill. Conics are split across the three syllabus sub-topics MAT2_PARABOLA, MAT2_ELLIPSE and MAT2_HYPERBOLA rather than lumped under one code - the split the old MAT_COORD_CONIC could not express. Second consecutive batch needing no new topics. All descriptions are plain text with no backslashes.
